concerns.text: FR-001 mandates a stratified subset of ≥ 50,000 audio clips from 'CHiME-5'. Tasks T007a/b and T007d substitute this with LibriSpeech/CORAA (~4,300 clips) and document the deviation, but no task exists to explicitly resolve the statistical power conflict (f² ≥ 0.02 vs f² ≥ 0.05) or to update the spec's power analysis requirement. The spec's FR-001 remains unmet by the task list.

FR-011 requires human annotations from ≥ 1,000 transcripts with ≥ 3 raters for SSS validation (AUC ≥ 0.85). Tasks T050b/c only support a manual pilot of N=100 clips or synthetic placeholders. There is no task to execute the full crowdsourcing protocol or validate the N=1,000 requirement, leaving FR-011 and SC-006 unsatisfied.

FR-013 and SC-003 require a statistical comparison between a full non-linear model and an additive linear model to confirm synergistic failure modes. Tasks T023-T025 only implement interaction term generation and single model training. No task exists to fit the additive baseline model and perform the required variance-explained comparison (p < 0.05, FDR-corrected).

FR-018 requires validating synthetic distortions against ≥ 50 real-world DNS Challenge clips. Task T012b implements the validator logic, but no task exists to fetch the DNS subset, generate matching synthetic clips, and execute the validation to produce the evidence artifact.

FR-010 requires normalizing the SSS collapse threshold relative to each model's clean-audio baseline. Tasks T020b/c calculate and store baselines, but no explicit task exists to perform the normalization step (dividing stress curve SSS by baseline) before the collapse detection logic in T019 runs.

SC-002 and SC-005 require measuring the stability of the 'critical interaction vector' against curve morphology (sigmoid vs. linear). Task T053 only sweeps the threshold parameter (0.40-0.60) and does not include a step to explicitly vary or classify curve morphology to test stability against that specific variable.

Task T012 describes the SNR range as 'A range of signal-to-noise ratios...' without explicitly listing the 9 required levels defined in FR-024 and the plan. This ambiguity risks implementation drift where the wrong number of SNR levels might be generated.
